Replacement dust bags for the self-empty station of the eufy X8 Pro and X10 Pro Omni robot vacuums.
The large bags hold more dust and filter fine particles such as food crumbs, hair and pet dander.
Made of melt-blown and non-woven fabric, the bag captures 99.7% of ultra-fine dust and helps extend the service life of your vacuum.
Change the dust bag every 2 to 3 months to keep the robot running at peak performance.
